info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Banking Accounts Alerts-v1-spec
info.description: The Banking Accounts Alerts Retrieval API allows users to access a comprehensive list of alerts associated with their banking accounts. This endpoint provides valuable insights into account activities and potential issues that need attention. Typical consumers include banking applications and financial services platforms that aim to enhance user engagement and proactive account management. By retrieving alerts, users can stay informed about their accounts and take necessary actions based on the information provided.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch a list of alerts associated with their accounts. It provides necessary information on account-related notifications and updates.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve alerts for accounts. It should contain the necessary parameters to specify which alerts to fetch and can include filters to tailor the response.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the list of alerts for the account.

ListBankingAccountsAlertsRequest.description: A JSON string representation of the request body for retrieving alerts associated with accounts.
